results.name: unindexed_computed_expression_aggregation

results.optimized_sql: WITH filtered_order_items AS (SELECT oi.product_id, oi.order_id, oi.quantity, oi.unit_price, (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS line_total FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'refunded') AND (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) >= 150.0), aggregated AS (SELECT product_id, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_distinct_orders, SUM(quantity) AS total_units_sold, ROUND(SUM(line_total), 2) AS total_sales_value, ROUND(AVG(unit_price), 2) AS avg_unit_price FROM filtered_order_items GROUP BY product_id HAVING SUM(line_total) > 5000.0) SELECT product_id, total_distinct_orders, total_units_sold, total_sales_value, avg_unit_price FROM aggregated ORDER BY total_sales_value DESC LIMIT 25;

Used CTE to avoid repeated computation of line_total
Preserved original semantics exactly
